people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Bene-jaakan
people.line: Israelite encampment during the wilderness wanderings.

people.name: Eleazar
people.line: Son of Aaron, high priest after his father

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moserah
people.line: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings

translations.web: (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.
translations.bsb: The Israelites traveled from Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar his son succeeded him as priest.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest's office
translations.asv: (And the children of Israel journeyed from Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest's office in his stead.
